Deringer, Inc.173 West Service RoadChamplain, NY 12919RE:  Clarification of HQ 959834, dated October 9, 1996Dear Ms. Cooper:     This is in regard to Headquarters Ruling Letter (HQ) 959834issued to you from this office on October 9, 1996.  In HQ 959834Customs determined the country of origin of certain comfortersand a pillow pursuant to Section 102.21, Customs Regulations (19CFR 102.21).  Additionally, the analysis discussed whether thesubject merchandise qualified for preferential tariff  treatmentpursuant to the North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA) asper Article 401.  Upon further review, Customs has determinedthat the holding stated in HQ 959834 should be clarified.     Although the holding correctly stated that the comfortersand pillow were eligible for the NAFTA preference, it did notclearly indicate the rate of duty for that merchandise.  As such,this is to inform you that the applicable rate of duty for thecomforters is 1 percent ad valorem, and 1.2 percent ad valoremfor the pillow.                          Sincerely,                         John Durant, Director                         Tariff Classification Appeals Division
